Conclusion: The test `testGetprop4()` checks whether the `IRFactory.TransformDispatcher.processPropertyGet(com.google.javascript.rhino.head.ast.PropertyGet)` method correctly handles property get operations. However, the method does not check if the property being accessed is a property of an object. As a result, it will return a `Node` object with the property name as a `Token.GETPROP` node, without any additional information about the object being accessed. This can lead to incorrect results when trying to access properties of objects. The bug is likely caused by the missing check for the type of the property being accessed. To fix this bug
